_comment: User-facing wording for the assessment components. Advisory decision support, not veterinary diagnosis.
disclaimer: Advisory decision support only. This is not a veterinary diagnosis.

flags.weight_loss: Weight dropped between the last two weigh-ins.
flags.stalled_gain: Daily gain has stayed at or below the configured minimum for the configured number of weigh-ins.
flags.relative_drop: Latest daily gain is well below this pig's own earlier average.

pen_thermal_message: unusual thermal reading in this pen; check the pigs
pen_comparison_note: Comparison with the pen median only; not a verdict on the pig.
benchmark_label: Commercial benchmark for optimized PIC-sired pigs (PIC Wean to Finish Guidelines 2019). Context only; not a standard for this farm.
forecast_note: Point forecast of the measured value. It is not a probability of heat stress or disease.

comfort: Conditions are in the comfort band. Continue regular monitoring.
watch: THI is in the watch band. Check ventilation, shade and drinking water.
heat_risk: THI is in the heat-risk band. Check the pigs, ventilation, shade and water, and follow your farm's cooling routine.
not_configured: THI bands are not configured yet; ask the farm administrator to set them.
insufficient_data: Not enough sensor data for an assessment. Check that the sensor is online.
unavailable: The latest reading failed data-quality checks. Check the sensor before relying on it.

compat_pig_insight: Growth checks now use this pig's own weight history. Open Weight History to see its daily gain and any flags.
